omega.description: An adversarial AI experiment in which four simulated veto players in the Ukraine war rejected an engineered peace deal. The original paper concluded that peace is architecturally impossible under current rules. That conclusion has since been withdrawn: one rejected proposal cannot prove that no settlement exists. The paper is kept online with a revision note on what survives and what was tested.

modelEvaluation.description: Six leading AI models tackle the same civilizational challenge. Which architectural approach proves most robust? An empirical validation of cognitive diversity in AI collaboration.
